pages.text: The Supply Terminal lets your farm feed a village. The village posts $(l)contracts$() on it, asking for food and materials, and pays you in emeralds and parts.
Place one in a village, or find one in a $(l:drone_systems/tech_village)Drone Mechanist's Outpost$(/l). An unemployed villager takes it as his job site and runs the contracts.

An unemployed villager takes the terminal as his job site, like a farmer takes a composter, and becomes a $(l)Drone Mechanist$(): a villager in goggles and a white work coat. While he works it, the terminal shows his level and the village's contracts.
pages.title: The Drone Mechanist

pages.text: The board shows the contracts from afar too:$(br)$(li)a lit card for each open contract, filling up as you deliver;$(br)$(li)the event's card in steel, blinking in a raid;$(br)$(li)a finished contract's card drops behind the board and a new one rises;

$(li)the header is lit while the Mechanist works the terminal.$(br)$(l)Right-click$() him to talk: he has a plan for a $(l:drone_systems/tech_village)tech village$(/l). His trades are behind the $(l)Trade$() button at the end of each talk.

The board holds $(l)three contracts$(). Every $(l)two minutes$() the mechanist fills the free places. Each contract asks for a quantity of one item. As the mechanist levels up, new goods join the ones he already asks for:$(br)$(li)$(l)Novice$(): bread, carrots, potatoes, wheat, beetroot, apples, white wool
pages.title: Contracts

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Apprentice$(): cooked beef, leather, oak logs, eggs, pumpkins, melon slices$(br)$(li)$(l)Journeyman$(): iron ingots, cooked chicken, glass, cod, string$(br)$(li)$(l)Expert$(): aluminum ingots, Basic Circuits, gold ingots$(br)$(li)$(l)Master$(): carbon fiber, Advanced Circuits
The higher his level, the bigger the contracts and the better they pay. No two are quite the same size.

Put the goods in the $(l)Deliver$() slot: by hand, with a hopper, or as the destination of a $(l:drone_systems/modules)Transport drone$(/l)'s route. The terminal only takes what is still wanted, so a drone brings exactly what the contracts need and nothing more.
pages.title: Delivering

pages.text: Some contracts pay a $(l)bonus$() besides their emeralds, shown on the row: battery cells, circuits, addons, carbon fiber, even an Anchor Addon from an expert mechanist or an Elite Circuit from a master.

The fourth place on the board is for the village's events:$(br)$(li)$(l)Market Day$(): every morning the village holds a market, a contract $(l)three times$() the usual size and pay, always with a bonus. It closes at dusk: fill it in time.
pages.title: Events

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Call to arms$(): while a $(l)raid$() is on the village asks for iron, arrows or shields. Fill it and $(l)two iron golems$() join the fight.

Every filled contract makes the village more $(l)prosperous$(): its emeralds count as points.$(br2)Once you have founded the $(l:drone_systems/tech_village)tech village$(/l) with the Mechanist:$(br)$(li)the bar under the board shows the village's level and how far the next one is;
pages.title: Prosperity

pages.text: $(li)the $(l)Range$() switch beside it outlines the village's bounds in the world.$(br)When the bar is full and the last level's buildings stand, $(l)talk to the Mechanist$() to raise the village a level. The village grows, a baby villager or an iron golem arrives, and it rings its bell. It makes you its hero: $(l)Hero of the Village$() for

twenty minutes, stronger at each level, with big discounts and gifts from the villagers.$(br2)At the top level, $(l)10$(), every contract pays half again. The levels are listed on $(l:drone_systems/tech_village)The Tech Village$(/l) page.

A filled contract:$(br)$(li)pays $(l)emeralds$(), and any bonus, into the $(l)Pay$() slot (take them by hand, or with a hopper or a drone);$(br)$(li)gives the mechanist $(l)experience$(): he levels up, from Novice to Master, unlocking bigger contracts and new trades;
pages.title: Rewards

pages.text: $(li)makes the village $(l)like you$(): every villager around gives you better prices, the mechanist most of all. The goodwill goes to whoever founded the village (before that, to whoever placed the terminal).

The Drone Mechanist sells CyberFarm parts for emeralds, more as he levels up:$(br)$(li)$(l)Novice$(): Basic Circuits; buys redstone$(br)$(li)$(l)Apprentice$(): Battery Cells; buys copper$(br)$(li)$(l)Journeyman$(): Advanced Circuits, Aluminum Ingots
pages.title: The mechanist's trades

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Expert$(): Speed and Stack Addons, Carbon Fiber$(br)$(li)$(l)Master$(): Elite Circuits, the Anchor Addon
